name: Gulf of Trieste

coastline.source: EMODnet Bathymetry satellite-derived coastline, Mean High Water (Miramare tile edge from the ITA file; clipped by trieste/prep_coast.py)
EMODnet Bathymetry satellite-derived coastline, Mean High Water, moles and breakwaters

terrain: one height per input until the NASADEM terrain step: the Karst edge behind Barcola and Trieste at 350 m, breakwaters 6 m
note: the bora is a fall wind off the Karst and leaves no lee on the water, so the land wake is off (wind.shadow_max 0); the shore still turns the wind

briefing.tip: Gusts come off the Karst in dark lines; tack on every header.
